name: Mitchell Makos
bio: Mitchell is a senior platform architect and full-stack engineer with a decade of experience shipping production systems at enterprise scale — from IBM Cloud Garage to Hertz, NCR, Fidelity, Royal Bank of Canada, Pacific Gas & Electric, and Erie Insurance.

At Alphabyte, Mitchell leads Claude platform engineering and infrastructure delivery. He designs the agentic systems, custom MCP servers, and governed AI environments that mid-market organizations run in production — connecting their existing tools, knowledge bases, and cloud infrastructure into Claude workflows their teams actually use.
achievements: Built a multi-agent orchestration system compressing platform delivery from months to days
Built a complete HIPAA-compliant healthcare platform in 18 days as a solo engineer
Built AzureConduit MCP server bridging Azure, D365, M365, Fabric, and Sentinel to Claude
Led 60 engineers in full-scale reconstruction of Auto Approve's technology stack
At IBM: helped recoup $32M in losses for Hertz, contributing to $40M in additional IBM contracts
Contributed to NCR's $130M Zynstra contract through cloud-native POS modernization
